r_aa.reason: Anti-aliasing mode: a quality / cost trade at the same visibility; picked by the level.

r_aniso.reason: Texture mips / anisotropic filtering: quality only.

r_ao.reason: AO / contact shadows / SSR / SSGI: lighting quality tiers. SSR only reflects pixels already on screen (no new information).

r_atmosphere.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Atmosphere / aerial perspective: distant haze. sky_aerial_scale was archived and player-settable 0 .. 20.

r_auto_exposure.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Exposure: compensation (+-4 EV) and auto-exposure on/off move the night darkness floor; the Off level has fixed exposure today (V10).

r_bloom.reason: Bloom on / off follows the level; its strength is locked to the Look (r_bloom_intensity).

r_bloom_intensity.reason: Look-owned: tonemapper and bloom / flare / dirt / distortion strength belong to the Look; a glare or distortion slider changes what you see near lights and the sun. Flare / dirt / distortion are 0 at every level today.

r_brightness.reason: Brightness: kept for display calibration but narrowed to 0.85 .. 1.15 (was 0.3 .. 3.0, which lifted the night darkness floor). Applied after tonemapping like before.

r_char_maps.reason: Character skin PBR maps: shading quality.

r_char_normal_scale.reason: Character normal map strength: authored value.

r_char_quality.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Character quality only scaled the character LOD thresholds (0.5 .. 1.25x by level, V4): fixed at 2 (x1).

r_chromatic.reason: Film grain, chromatic aberration, vignette, sharpening: cosmetic, each bounded by the level and the Look.

r_classic_impostor_px.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Impostor switch size decides when trees turn into cards; vgeo 16 px vs classic 64 px today, and tiers 96 .. 16 px (V2); locked 32 px for both renderers.

r_cloud_shadows.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Cloud shadows darken patches of the map: Off / Low drop them (V5).

r_colorblind.reason: Colour-blind correction: accessibility; remaps hues, not luminance, at every level (Off included).

r_contact_shadows.reason: AO / contact shadows / SSR / SSGI: lighting quality tiers. SSR only reflects pixels already on screen (no new information).

r_cpu_skinning.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Wireframe / hitboxes / collision / CPU skinning / third person: wallhack-class views, dev only.

r_culling.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Frustum culling on/off (dev toggle).

r_dof.reason: Depth of field Off / When aiming / Always: cosmetic, only ever blurs your own view. Off also disables the ADS weapon blur (ads_dof).

r_drawcollision.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Wireframe / hitboxes / collision / CPU skinning / third person: wallhack-class views, dev only.

r_drawhitboxes.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Wireframe / hitboxes / collision / CPU skinning / third person: wallhack-class views, dev only.

r_era.reason: Era: kept editable, but eras may only change geometry *style* and cost (vgeo vs classic, shading). Their foliage density and LOD columns move to the locked set (see violations V1 / V3).

r_exposure.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Exposure: compensation (+-4 EV) and auto-exposure on/off move the night darkness floor; the Off level has fixed exposure today (V10).

r_fb_underwater.reason: Post compare / profile / volumes / underwater hook / disabled passes: dev tools (r_post_disable can drop the fog pass).

r_fidelity.reason: Engine Fidelity level: the one quality choice a player makes.

r_fidelity_autodetect.reason: Fidelity bookkeeping written by the game (benchmark results, recommendation, auto-detect, target fps).

r_fidelity_bench.reason: Fidelity bookkeeping written by the game (benchmark results, recommendation, auto-detect, target fps).

r_fidelity_custom.reason: Player tweaks of EDITABLE fidelity features only (render scale, upscaler, motion blur, DoF, grain, CA, vignette, sharpen). TIER / LOCKED features are no longer stored here; old entries are dropped on load.

r_fidelity_recommended.reason: Fidelity bookkeeping written by the game (benchmark results, recommendation, auto-detect, target fps).

r_fidelity_target_fps.reason: Fidelity bookkeeping written by the game (benchmark results, recommendation, auto-detect, target fps).
